summary.name: The Practice of Cloud System Administration
summary.one_liner: A book on designing and operating large distributed and cloud systems, covering architecture and design patterns plus modern operations practices including devops.
keywords: the practice of cloud system administration
use_cases: learning architecture patterns for large-scale systems
understanding devops and modern operations practice
onboarding sysadmins or managers to cloud concepts
motivating operations improvements in an organization
studying lessons from production outages and post-mortems
summary.what_it_does: The page is a set of reader endorsements for the book The Practice of Cloud System Administration (TPOCSA), not a product description. According to the reviews, the first part covers architecture and design patterns for large-scale systems, and the second part surveys operations best practices, including devops. Reviewers describe it as drawing on lessons from Internet site operations and post-mortem experience. The page itself gives no table of contents or detailed chapter list.
notable: Two-part structure: architecture and design patterns, then operations best practices including devops
Reviewers cite lessons from Internet site operations and outage post-mortems
Recommended in the awesome-sre books list
caveats: Page contains only reader testimonials; no price, format, or edition details are given
Reviewers note a single book will not by itself change an organization's practices
